Test Name: Balance Sheet Equality Check (Assets = Liab & Equity)
Audit Criteria: Assets minus Total Liab & Equity must equal zero across all periods

Test Name: Cash Flow Reconciliation (Opening + Net CF = Closing)
Audit Criteria: Closing cash balance must tie to balance sheet cash without plug

Test Name: PP&E Roll-Forward Check (Opening + CapEx - Depr = Closing)
Audit Criteria: Net block roll-forward must exactly reconcile with Income Statement Depr

Test Name: Debt Schedule Check (Opening + Borrow - Repay = Closing)
Audit Criteria: Debt movements must match Cash Flow Statement financing section
Ending Reserves = Beginning Reserves + Net Income - Dividends
WACC must exceed long-term terminal growth rate g
Finite DCF condition: Cost of capital must strictly exceed terminal growth
